therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell division arrest and tumor vasculature disruption
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Epithelial ovarian cancer, fallopian tube cancer, primary peritoneal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival differences between ixabepilone alone and ixabepilone + bevacizumab

subgroup_findings: Prior taxane treatment analysis showed p=0.068 for response differences
safety_signals: Small intestinal obstruction (5/37 ixabepilone vs 3/39 combination)
results.dose_information: Ixabepilone 20 mg/m2 IV days 1,8,15 of 28-day cycle; Bevacizumab 10 mg/kg IV days 1,15 of 28-day cycle
